additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed the valueset-concept-comments StructureDefinition source during the R5 extension-source move. Current FHIR-core has no active fhir.ini/source definition entry for this extension and only retains source/oids.ini registration. The FHIR Extension Pack source at input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-concept-comments.xml owns the current definition and uses the renamed id/url/fixedUri. FHIR-51904 is a later Submitted, unresolved FHIR-extensions issue about adding another context to the same extension and is not a final core decision.
